message: I'm buying a T45 Utility with front loader and 3-year extended warranty, paying in full today. Heartland Tractor posts the same package for $49,375 before negotiation. My budget is $39,000 all-in for T45 + loader + warranty. Can you do $39,000?

Thanks for the clear request. Our list price for the T45 Utility with front loader and 3-year extended warranty is $50,900, so $39,000 is more than we can do on that package. Since you're paying in full today, I can bring the full package down to $48,400. If budget is tight, we could also look at dropping the extended warranty to lower the total.
$48,400 is still well over what I can do. I can stretch to $40,500 for the full package, cash today.

I appreciate you moving up, and paying in full today does help. $40,500 is still below what we can do on the full package, though. I can come down to $46,500 for the T45 Utility with front loader and 3-year extended warranty. If you need to get closer to your budget, removing the extended warranty would lower the total quite a bit. I'm happy to price that option for you.
I want to keep the warranty. I can go to $42,000 for the full package — that's my offer, ready to pay now.

Thanks for coming up to $42,000. I know you want to keep the warranty. That's still below what we can do on the full package, but I'll meet you closer. I can do $44,800 for the T45 Utility with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty, paid in full today. That's $6,100 off list.
We're close. $42,800 and I check out right now.

We really are close, and I want to get this done for you today. I can't go to $42,800 on this package, but I'll meet you most of the way: $43,800 for the T45 Utility with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty, paid in full today. That's $7,100 off list, and you can check out right now.
Split the difference: $43,300 and it's done.
You've got a deal. $43,300 for the T45 Utility with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty, paid in full today. Thanks for working with us. You're all set to check out.
